title: Diabetes Mellitus (糖尿病)
sources: Harrison's 22e - Ch.415 DM: Diagnosis, Classification, Pathophysiology (p.3238-3247)
Harrison's 22e - Ch.416 DM: Management and Therapies (p.3248-3263)

sections.title: Overview / Epidemiology
content: Diabetes mellitus (DM) 是一群以 **hyperglycemia** 為共同表現的代謝疾病，因 insulin 分泌不足、作用缺陷或兩者兼有所致。

content.text: DM 是美國 ESRD、非外傷性下肢截肢、成人失明的首要原因。心血管疾病是 DM 患者最主要的致死原因。

content: 全球約 5.37 億人患有糖尿病（2021 年），預計 2045 年將達 7.83 億人。Type 2 DM 佔 90-95%，Type 1 DM 佔 5-10%。

rows: Autoimmune beta cell destruction → absolute insulin deficiency
Insulin resistance + relative insulin deficiency + increased hepatic glucose production
通常 > 40 歲 (但越來越年輕化)

content.text:
**I. Type 1 DM**: Immune-mediated beta cell destruction
**II. Type 2 DM**: Insulin resistance + secretory defect
**III. Other specific types**:
- MODY (Monogenic diabetes): AD inheritance, onset < 25 y/o
  - MODY 1: HNF4α
  - MODY 2: Glucokinase (mild fasting hyperglycemia)
  - MODY 3: HNF1α (most common)
- Diseases of exocrine pancreas: Pancreatitis, CF, hemochromatosis
- Endocrinopathies: Acromegaly, Cushing's, Pheochromocytoma
- Drug-induced: Glucocorticoids, Thiazides, Calcineurin inhibitors
- Gestational DM (GDM)
**IV. Gestational DM**

Type 1 DM 的三個 stages:
- Stage 1: Autoantibodies (+), normoglycemia
- Stage 2: Autoantibodies (+), dysglycemia (IFG/IGT)
- Stage 3: Clinical diabetes (symptomatic hyperglycemia)

sections.title: Pathophysiology
content: 遺傳易感性（HLA-DR3/DR4）+ 環境觸發 → T cell-mediated autoimmune destruction of pancreatic beta cells → absolute insulin deficiency。Beta cell mass 破壞 > 80-90% 時出現臨床症狀。

content.text:
Type 2 DM 的 pathophysiology triad:
1. **Insulin resistance** (muscle, liver, adipose tissue)
2. **Impaired insulin secretion** (beta cell dysfunction → eventually beta cell failure)
3. **Increased hepatic glucose production** (gluconeogenesis)

items: **Insulin resistance**: Obesity → increased FFA → lipotoxicity → 干擾 insulin signaling → 肌肉 glucose uptake 減少
**Beta cell dysfunction**: 初期代償性 hyperinsulinemia → 漸進性 beta cell failure → insulin 分泌不足
**Hepatic glucose production**: Insulin 無法抑制肝臟 gluconeogenesis → fasting hyperglycemia
**Incretin effect 減弱**: GLP-1 和 GIP 對 beta cell 的 insulin secretion 刺激效果下降
**Glucagon excess**: Alpha cell dysfunction → inappropriate glucagon secretion

content.text:
Prediabetes 的進展：
Normal → Impaired Fasting Glucose (IFG) / Impaired Glucose Tolerance (IGT) → Type 2 DM

IFG: Fasting glucose 100-125 mg/dL
IGT: 2h OGTT glucose 140-199 mg/dL
HbA1c 5.7-6.4% 也可視為 prediabetes

items: **Type 1**: Insulitis (lymphocytic infiltration of islets) → beta cell destruction → islet atrophy
**Type 2**: Amyloid deposition in islets (islet amyloid polypeptide/amylin) → beta cell loss (減少 20-65%)

content.text: Kimmelstiel-Wilson nodules (nodular glomerulosclerosis) 是 DM nephropathy 的特徵性病理，但 diffuse mesangial expansion 更常見且出現更早

items: **Polyuria**: Osmotic diuresis from glucosuria
**Polydipsia**: Compensatory thirst
**Polyphagia**: Cellular starvation despite hyperglycemia
**Weight loss**: Especially Type 1 (catabolic state)

content.text:
LADA (Latent Autoimmune Diabetes in Adults)：
成人發病但有 autoantibodies → 初期像 Type 2 但漸進需要 insulin
若成人 DM 對 oral agents 效果差且 BMI 正常，考慮檢測 Anti-GAD65

DM 診斷標準 (ADA, 符合任一即可，需重複確認)：
1. **Fasting plasma glucose (FPG)** >= 126 mg/dL
2. **2h OGTT** >= 200 mg/dL (75g glucose load)
3. **HbA1c** >= 6.5%
4. **Random glucose** >= 200 mg/dL + classic symptoms (不需重複)

items: **Anti-GAD65** (Glutamic acid decarboxylase): Most sensitive, persists longest
**Anti-IA2** (Insulinoma-associated antigen 2)
**Anti-insulin antibodies (IAA)**: Most useful in children
**Anti-ZnT8** (Zinc transporter 8)

content.text:
HbA1c 反映過去 2-3 個月的平均血糖（紅血球壽命 120 天）

注意 HbA1c 不準確的情況：
- 溶血性貧血、血紅素病變 → 偏低
- 鐵缺乏性貧血、脾切除 → 偏高
- 懷孕、CKD → 可能不準確

sections.title: Treatment

content.text:
ADA 治療目標：
- HbA1c < 7% (一般成人)
- HbA1c < 6.5% (年輕、無併發症、低低血糖風險)
- HbA1c < 8% (老年、多重共病、預期壽命短)
- Preprandial glucose: 80-130 mg/dL
- Peak postprandial glucose: < 180 mg/dL

content: **Insulin** is essential and lifelong. Basal-bolus regimen or insulin pump (CSII).

content.text:
**Rapid-acting** (onset 15 min, peak 1-2h, duration 3-5h):
- Lispro, Aspart, Glulisine

**Short-acting** (onset 30 min, peak 2-4h, duration 6-8h):
- Regular insulin

**Intermediate** (onset 1-2h, peak 4-8h, duration 12-16h):
- NPH

**Long-acting** (onset 1-2h, no peak, duration 20-24h):
- Glargine (Lantus), Detemir (Levemir)

**Ultra-long-acting** (onset 1h, no peak, duration >42h):
- Degludec (Tresiba)

rows: Decrease hepatic glucose production, improve insulin sensitivity
First-line, weight neutral, no hypoglycemia, CV benefit
Lactic acidosis (rare), GI side effects, 禁用 eGFR < 30
CV & renal benefit, weight loss, BP reduction
UTI, Genital mycosis, euglycemic DKA, 截肢風險 (canagliflozin)
Incretin mimetic → insulin secretion, suppress glucagon
CV benefit, weight loss, no hypoglycemia
GI side effects (nausea), 禁用 MTC/MEN2 family hx, Pancreatitis risk
Weight gain, edema, HF, fractures, bladder cancer (pioglitazone)

content.text:
ADA/EASD 2022 Type 2 DM 治療流程：
1. **Metformin** + lifestyle modification (first-line for all)
2. 合併 ASCVD or high risk → add **GLP-1 RA** or **SGLT2i** (有 CV benefit)
3. 合併 HF or CKD → add **SGLT2i** (preferred) or GLP-1 RA
4. 需要額外降糖 → 依個別情況加 DPP-4i, TZD, SU, or insulin
5. HbA1c > 10% or symptoms → consider insulin early

items: **HbA1c**: 每 3 個月 (未達標) 或每 6 個月 (穩定控制)
**Self-monitoring blood glucose (SMBG)**: Type 1 至少 4 次/天; Type 2 依治療方案
**Eye exam**: 每年散瞳眼底檢查
**Foot exam**: 每次就診檢查 + 每年完整足部評估
**Renal function**: 每年 UACR + eGFR
**Lipid panel**: 每年

rows: Type 1: 5 yr after dx; Type 2: at diagnosis
Type 1: 5 yr after dx; Type 2: at diagnosis
Type 1: 5 yr after dx; Type 2: at diagnosis

content.text:
DCCT/UKPDS legacy effect:
早期嚴格血糖控制的好處可持續數十年（metabolic memory），即使後來控制放鬆。強調 early intensive control 的重要性。

sections.title: Special Populations
content: 妊娠 24-28 週篩檢（75g OGTT）。治療首選 lifestyle modification → insulin（Metformin 可考慮但非首選）。產後 4-12 週重新評估糖代謝。
Metformin 為 first-line oral agent (FDA approved for age >= 10)。近年與肥胖流行相關，發病率快速增加。
HbA1c 目標可放寬至 < 8%（避免 hypoglycemia）。Avoid SU 和 sliding-scale insulin。優先使用低低血糖風險藥物（Metformin, DPP-4i, SGLT2i）。
SGLT2i 在 eGFR >= 20 可使用（renoprotective benefit > glycemic benefit）。Metformin 禁用於 eGFR < 30。Insulin 劑量需減少（腎臟清除減少）。

content.text:
DKA vs HHS 鑑別：
- DKA: Type 1 (也可 Type 2), pH < 7.3, HCO3 < 18, Ketones (+), AG metabolic acidosis
- HHS: Type 2, Glucose > 600, Osmolality > 320, 意識改變, 無顯著 acidosis

共同：Dehydration + electrolyte imbalance + hyperglycemia
治療共同原則：IV fluids (first!) → Insulin → K+ correction

DKA 治療注意：
- 先補液再給 insulin（否則加重低血壓）
- K+ < 3.3 → 先補鉀再給 insulin（insulin 會讓 K+ 進入細胞更低）
- 不要用 HCO3 除非 pH < 6.9
- Glucose 降到 200-250 → 改 D5W + insulin drip（避免 cerebral edema）

必記藥物重點：
- **Metformin**: First-line Type 2, 禁用 eGFR < 30, lactic acidosis
- **SGLT2i**: CV + renal benefit, -gliflozin, euglycemic DKA, genital infection
- **GLP-1 RA**: CV benefit, weight loss, 禁用 MTC/MEN2 hx
- **Sulfonylureas**: Hypoglycemia risk, 尤其 glyburide (elderly 禁用)
- **Insulin Glargine**: Long-acting, no peak (好用作 basal insulin)

items: Type 1 DM: Anti-GAD65 most sensitive autoantibody
Type 2 DM: Metformin first-line, 加 SGLT2i/GLP-1 RA if ASCVD/HF/CKD
HbA1c reflects 2-3 month average; goal < 7% (general)
DKA: 先補液 → 補鉀 (if K < 3.3) → Insulin → 到 glucose 200-250 加 D5W
MODY: AD inheritance, onset < 25, most common = MODY 3 (HNF1α)
Diabetic nephropathy: First sign = microalbuminuria (UACR 30-300 mg/g)
Kimmelstiel-Wilson nodules = pathognomonic for diabetic nephropathy
GDM screening: 24-28 weeks with 75g OGTT
